reply: Three-term searches over a library of power, exponential and Arrhenius-type factors reached about 1.5e-5 at best, still not at 1e-12. Two of my own structures ran to 6.9e-3 and 2.0e-3 (the one with separate temperature powers on each term). The last one, which adds a 1/T-type term, reached 4.1e-5.
